guidance.sentence: For the full year 2026, on a pro forma basis, the Company forecasts total revenue of $2.83-$2.86 billion, pro forma organic revenue growth of 4-5%, and pro forma adjusted earnings per share of $5.30-$5.40.

summary: Revvity raised its full-year 2026 guidance, now on a pro forma basis that excludes China IDX, forecasting total revenue of $2.83-$2.86 billion, pro forma organic revenue growth of 4-5%, and pro forma adjusted EPS of $5.30-$5.40.
